title: All About Me
titleUk: Знайомство, розпорядок дня і Present Simple
summary: Getting to know each other, a quick level check, daily routine words and the base of the NMT grammar: to be, Present Simple (positive, negative, questions) and adverbs of frequency. Plus your first NMT-style task.

title: People Around Me
summary: How to describe people — what they look like and what they are like — and the Present Continuous for things happening right now. Then the key NMT choice: Present Simple or Present Continuous? Plus state verbs and an NMT-style task.
